name: g02-calendar-aisle
prompt: A long aisle between towering warehouse racks stacked with plain brown cardboard cartons, warm golden-hour light streaming in from the open shutter at the far end. Surreal, dreamlike yet photorealistic, cinematic, 35 mm film look, soft volumetric light, shallow depth of field, a warm palette of gold, sand and deep emerald green. No text, no numbers, no lettering, no logos, no signs anywhere in the picture.
